themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, or review code, and the associated security and reliability concerns.

themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and execute complex workflows with minimal human intervention.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI applications that condense large amounts of text, such as research papers, earnings calls, or meeting transcripts, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Articles about platforms and tools designed to facilitate or accelerate scientific, market, or user research using AI capabilities.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Discusses a broad range of AI-powered tools used for various research purposes, including data analysis, insight generation, and workflow enhancement.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the research, capabilities, limitations, and ethical implications of AI chatbots, including their use in communication and support.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare different AI tools for research purposes, evaluating their features, performance, and suitability for specific tasks.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Examines the use of AI to create artificial user personas or data for testing and research, and the implications of AI-generated content.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Investigates the impact of AI on job markets, hiring processes, and workforce dynamics, including job creation, displacement, and bias.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI is integrated into design processes and user research methodologies, including AI-assisted design tools and generative design.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
